series.name: Tempting the Ruthless CEO
series.summary: Julian corners his undercover assistant Aria with evidence of corporate espionage, demanding a forced marriage of convenience to save her family from ruin. At a high-society gala, Sebastian confronts his former flame Aria, only for Julian to intervene and publicly claim her as his bride.

chars.name: Aria Bennett
chars.desc: 24-year-old female, fair porcelain skin, waist-length wavy dark chestnut hair, delicate doe eyes, high cheekbones, wearing a tailored lavender wool trench coat over a minimalist cream silk slip dress
chars.role: Disgraced heiress operating undercover as a timid corporate assistant to clear her family's name; sharp-witted, fiercely determined, yet fighting her growing attraction to Julian

chars.name: Victoria Sterling
chars.desc: 26-year-old female, sun-kissed tan skin, sleek platinum blonde blunt bob, feline green eyes with sharp winged liner, defined contour, wearing an emerald-green silk halter gown and diamond teardrop earrings
chars.role: Status-obsessed socialite intended to marry Julian; vindictive, cunning, and determined to publicly ruin Aria the moment she detects competition

chars.name: Sebastian Vance
chars.desc: 29-year-old male, pale skin, sharply styled golden-blonde undercut, narrow calculating steel-blue eyes, thin mocking lips, wearing a sharp navy double-breasted designer blazer with gold crest buttons
chars.role: Julian's ruthless half-brother and Aria's treacherous ex-fiancé who framed her father; outwardly charismatic, secretly manipulative and possessive

chars.name: Julian Thorne
chars.desc: 28-year-old male, olive skin tone, raven-black hair slicked back with a few rogue strands over his forehead, piercing hazel eyes, sculpted jawline with faint stubble, wearing a bespoke charcoal three-piece suit with an open collar and platinum cufflinks
chars.role: Cold, dominant billionaire venture capitalist who entered a marriage of convenience to protect his empire, utterly blindsided by Aria's hidden fire and vulnerability

places.name: Thorne Tower Penthouse
places.desc: Ultra-modern luxury penthouse overlooking a rainy skyscraper skyline at night, floor-to-ceiling glass walls, sleek black marble fireplace, ambient amber lighting, and an expansive curved glass staircase

places.name: Aria's Secret Archive
places.desc: Dimly lit, cozy basement studio apartment in an old brick brownstone, one wall covered in financial blueprints and evidence pinned with red strings, illuminated by a solitary brass desk lamp

places.name: The Grand Ballroom at Sterling Estate
places.desc: Opulent neo-classical ballroom flooded with warm light from massive crystal chandeliers, gilded arched mirrors, champagne pyramids, velvet drapes, and polished parquet floors
